name: MUV
text: A digital game played in the real world. It rewards people who travel sustainably and measures the CO<sub>2</sub> they avoid with an algorithm certified by RINA to ISO 14064-II. Over 180,000 kilometres travelled sustainably, 21 cities. It is also the infrastructure that produces the data behind much of my research.

name: B-CIRCULAR
text: How to build a circular economy from textile waste, across three cities in southern Italy: Palermo, Cagliari, Reggio Calabria. Scientific lead, with Fondazione CON IL SUD.

name: Interferenze
text: A podcast where an environmental physicist and a room of design students trace everyday news back to the broken systems behind it.
